newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Capital (Holdings) unit Haddowe seeks loan.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Capital (Holdings) unit Haddowe seeks loan.

text.p: Rabobank Hong Kong is seeking sub-underwriters to join a term loan facility for Haddowe Ltd, Rabobank said on Thursday.
Haddowe is a subsidiary of Pacific Capital (Holdings) Ltd, which is engaged in the property business in Hong Kong and China.
The HK$475 million facility has been fully underwritten by the arranger. It carries a maturity of five years.
The loan facility will be secured by retail and carparking spaces. Proceeds will be used to refinance existing debts and for investment purposes.
Syndication will begin after the formation of a sub-underwriting group and the deal is expected to be completed in December.
Last February, the borrower completed a 4.5 year US$60 million term loan.
